title: Class-II source, translated model, balanced coefficient jets, and obstruction boundary
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production coefficients and A10-A13 strict sharp cubes, exact Class-II algebra and independently executed fixtures close several invalid proof architectures without closing the Nelson theorem. The translation, universal-Q, finite-forest, and balanced-jet continuations prove the flexible epsilon_6<gamma/6 range, the exact finite-cutoff translation/frame/Cartan identities, the universal centered derivative-square tensor in every finite moment, the 2, 4+2, 5+2, and 3+0 Wiener forests, and the full grouped rational A7 reconstruction with finite Sigma_Lambda Q_Lambda retained. The strict-past and backward-heat continuations derive q=(2 epsilon_v)^-1=10/9, the full score s_j=ell_j+m_j, the retained-square/Gibbs-Pythagoras charge, and the exact raw-current reduction. A13-CLASSII-NPC-CONE-MARTINGALE-INJECTION-REDUCTION diagonalises the production current at alpha=5/9, identifies the aggregate CAT(0) metric cone, proves the strong Jacobi remainder and exact raw-energy/injection telescope, and retires shellwise-positivity and geometry-only routes. A13-CLASSII-TIP-SAFE-GROUPED-HARVEST-CARLESON-REDUCTION now proves the exact nonlinear Tikhonov harvest, full conservative-score Carleson estimate, uncontrolled-Gaussian N^-1/N^-2 score tails, CAT(0) whole-secant inequality through the cone tip, floor-uniform physical endpoint distance, and a global centered H^(-1-kappa) one-use form estimate requiring random-norm exponent 3/(1-kappa), equal to 10/3 at kappa=1/10. Exact scalar and gauge-beat fixtures show that direct absolute score integration and a claimed full N^-3/2 nonlinear remainder are false architectures. The sole regular-control successor is the finite-cutoff tip-safe production good/bad Schur--Jacobi inequality with causal current grouping. The one-use and Nelson theorems remain open.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-TRANSLATION-UNIVERSAL-Q-BALANCED-JET-A7-RECONSTRUCTION-BACKWARD-HEAT-NPC-CONE-AND-TIP-SAFE-GROUPED-HARVEST-REDUCTION-WITH-EXECUTED-NOGOS@FIXED-FLOOR-SHARP-CUBE on L=16 for the A1 production symbol and coefficients, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, exact non-aliased Fourier products, common bounded entrywise-real-even scalar regulators, covariance-matched A7 Wick subtraction, and the A10-A13 dyadic rectangular-cube filtration. The latest theorem is finite-cutoff, uses inhomogeneous H2 physical control fields and 0<kappa<1 on the fixed three-torus, and applies to bounded cylindrical, or otherwise sufficiently integrable, strict-past controls with one mutually orthogonal control block per sharp shell. Its metric-cone statement uses the standard angle-clipped completion. Its N^-1/N^-2 score-tail statement is only at the uncontrolled terminal-backward Gaussian base and is not asserted after adapted control. It does not cover a progressive flow that revisits a Fourier range, prove the production good/bad Schur--Jacobi inequality, identify a finite first variation at every tip contact, or establish the localization/lower-semicontinuity extension to every finite-energy drift. The one-use theorem and umbrella gate remain open.
falsifier: A failure of any prior A13 Fierz, source, factor-four, determinant, translation/frame, Cartan, universal-Q, forest, balanced-jet, strict-past, backward-heat, or NPC-cone assertion remains a falsifier for its package. The latest continuation is falsified by a wrong sign or factor in the nonlinear harvest or full conservative score, failure of the uncontrolled-base N^-1/N^-2 covariance traces, failure of the CAT(0) whole-secant or floor-uniform physical-distance bound, use of a homogeneous zero-mode-blind control norm, a centered-form exponent different from 3/(1-kappa) or 10/3 at kappa=1/10, failure of the scalar Schur or gauge-beat identities, use of the Gaussian tail after adapted control, a source/PDF hash mismatch, a failed 27/27 primary, 22/22 independent, 61/61 integrated, 110/110 aggregate, nine-page PDF, or release assertion.

reproduction.expected: Primary 27/27, non-importing independent 22/22, integrated 61/61, and aggregate 110/110 PASS sentinel; exit 0.

no_overclaim: The latest theorem is an exact/analytic reduction for regular mutually orthogonal one-shot strict-past controls. It does not prove the tip-safe production good/bad Schur--Jacobi inequality, identify a finite first variation at every cone-tip contact, transfer uncontrolled Gaussian score tails after adapted control, extend to every finite-energy drift, prove the controlled-shell one-use inequality or q=10/9 Nelson moment, construct an interacting measure, remove the floor or regulator, take infinite volume, prove phase transition or BCC selection, or justify T5, T6, or T7. The gauge-beat and flat CAT(0) fixtures are not production counterexamples.
next_action: Continue under A13-CLASSII-NPC-CONE-MARTINGALE-INJECTION-BALANCE with the exact finite-cutoff tip-safe production good/bad Schur--Jacobi lemma. On the good region, complete the derivative displacement against the positive current/Jacobi square; on the bad cone-tip region, estimate the whole secant without retaining the invalid derivative-linear tangent. The uniform Schur complement must leave only the globally summed centered Q form plus an N^-3 trace term, while causal grouping telescopes pure-control current creation and applies the N^-1/N^-2 Gaussian score tail only to Gaussian-rooted terms. Then pass by localization and lower semicontinuity to the declared finite-energy class before invoking one-use.
